entities.name: PMID:27497911
observations: Liu et al. studied plasma miR-126-5p in 150 participants, including 110 patients with stable angina and angiographically characterized coronary disease.
Plasma miR-126-5p was measured by qRT-PCR; coronary disease extent/complexity was assessed by diseased-vessel number or multivessel disease and SYNTAX score.
Lower plasma miR-126-5p was reported in multivessel disease and higher SYNTAX-score groups.
The abstract does not establish adjusted independent associations or provide detailed effect sizes.

entities.name: miR-126-5p
observations: Circulating plasma miR-126-5p was lower in stable-angina patients with multivessel coronary disease and higher SYNTAX scores in the reported observational study.
Age, dyslipidemia, and diabetes were reported as factors affecting miR-126-5p; independent adjusted association with disease complexity/severity was not confirmed in the accessible abstract.

entities.name: Coronary artery disease
observations: In stable angina pectoris, coronary disease complexity/extent was represented by diseased-vessel number or multivessel disease, and angiographic complexity/severity by SYNTAX score in PMID:27497911.

entities.name: miR-126-5p-CAD association
observations: In a 2016 observational stable-angina cohort, lower plasma miR-126-5p was associated with both multivessel coronary disease and higher SYNTAX scores.
The result supports association with CAD complexity and angiographic severity, but not causality or a definitively independent biomarker effect.
